address_experiment.mode_1: Channel div/rem and head base outside token loop; one token div/rem per lane per wave
address_experiment.mode_2: Mode 1 channel maps; initial token div/rem once, recurrence after each wave including inactive lanes

attribution_controls.factored_v_identity: sum(p*(s*u+o)) = sum((p*s)*u) + sum(p*o); per-token V only
attribution_controls.normalized_fp16_buffer: Same FP16 normalized scalars, metadata and affine reconstruction as ordinary textures
attribution_controls.schedule: eight tokens per SIMD group wave; four lanes per token; D64 only
attribution_controls.uncompressed_rgba_texture: Ordinary RGBA16Float packing of the same normalized scalars; not RGBA ASTC

compact_atlas.block_order: head then block row then block column; each original 16-byte block unchanged
compact_atlas.padding_block_policy: duplicate first valid source block; never addressed by logical tensor

k_decode_gate.scope: engineering fixture check; no model-quality or exact ASTC equivalence claim

v_decode_gate.scope: engineering fixture check; no model-quality or exact ASTC equivalence claim

environment.note: Allocation is not a decoding test; full probe execution tests texture reads.

exchange_experiment.fallback: global odd pair start or missing peer uses own mapped direct reads
exchange_experiment.schedule: V fetched before softmax weights; even token_lane owns paired texture reads; unconditional xor4 sends odd V; original per-token weighting/reductions
exchange_experiment.scope: No paired weight or metadata arithmetic; gather throughput/register usage not measured directly

gather_experiment.gather_quad: even global token and channel form an in-block 2x2 footprint
gather_experiment.pairing: even token_lane owns its token and next token; odd global t or missing peer uses mapped direct reads
gather_experiment.scope: Source-level request count only; no measured instruction throughput, cache traffic or runtime speedup

input_manifest.status: synthetic repeated-real-block traffic control; NOT model-quality evidence
input_manifest.traffic_note: Same query, repeated old K/V. Padding texels repeat known encoded block rows. No fresh long-context forward.

memory.peak_note: Original and compact atlases plus all control GPU resources and CPU tensors coexist. Per-path persistent sums are not process peak or exclusive residency. Repacking/upload/decode are outside attention timing.

pipeline_metadata_scope: Public pipeline properties only; no profiler, register count, occupancy or instruction-count measurement
scope: precompressed, one-query diagnostic; no runtime speedup claim

timing.cache_state: repeated read of same cache; run large working sets separately
timing.variant_order: seeded 14-variant warmup; randomized comparison order and ABBA/BAAB blocks
